item.description: PH CAR OWNERS REPORT BETTER SALES AND SERVICE EXPERIENCES IN 2026, STUDY FINDS Gadgets Magazine The second annual Philippines Customer eXperience Index Study found that the industry's overall score rose from 856 to 864 in 2026, led by gains in sales (+24 points) and after-sales service (+21 points).
